items.synopsis: Diving off the California coast in search of his late father's remains, Jay Gardiner is swallowed by a massive sperm whale and must escape with only an hour of oxygen left, based on Daniel Kraus's novel.

items.title: The Cat in the Hat
items.synopsis: An animated feature adaptation of Dr. Seuss's beloved book, with Bill Hader voicing the mischievous, irreverent Cat.

items.title: Return of the Living Dead
items.synopsis: The sixth installment of the cult zombie-horror franchise.

items.title: Operation Safed Sagar
items.synopsis: Based on the Kargil War and the Indian Air Force's role — Siddharth plays Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja.
